hints: After avoiding damage for several seconds, regenerate health rapidly if you have enough bonus health. Also gain bonus health based on health from items.
Charge up near an enemy champion to empower your next attack against them, dealing bonus physical damage and permanently increasing your maximum health. Your size increases with maximum health.
Energized attacks unleash chain lightning that deals magic damage and applies on-hit effects to nearby targets. Basic attacks grant extra Energized stacks.
Damaging abilities slow enemies by 30% for one second.
Attacks deal bonus physical damage based on the target's current health. Attacking a champion three times slows them.
Magic damage that would drop you below 30% health grants a magic-damage shield and omnivamp until combat ends.
Gain basic ability haste. Dealing ability damage builds stacks that increase your ability and passive damage.
When an attack hits you, deal magic damage back to the attacker. If they are a champion, also apply a healing-reduction debuff.
